notes: Read c127.json (ES) and c21.json (UAE) first as instructed. India has NO dedicated Zara Home country storefront (unlike the 6 previously completed countries UAE/UK/DE/ES/Spain/France, each of which has its own unique storeId). CONFIRMED empirically: (1) https://www.zarahome.com/in/ returns HTTP 301 -> https://www.zarahome.com/es/ (Spain homepage, title 'Zara Home Espana | Sitio oficial'), reproduced twice; guessed alternate India slugs /india/, /inen/, /in_en/ all resolve to a generic empty SPA shell (title just 'Zara Home', 463KB, no content) confirming they are not real routes; /pk/ and /bd/ (Pakistan, Bangladesh) show the identical 301->/es/ redirect behavior as /in/. (2) The site's own store-list API (/itxrest/2/catalog/store?languageId=-1&brandId=8, 218 stores) contains an explicit India entry: storeId 88009900, countryCode IN, isOpenForSale true (web+Android+iOS), catalogs [{id:80290026,identifier:'ZH_WW_SEASON'},{id:80290086,identifier:'CATALOG_IOP_ZH'}]. Cross-checked storeId 88009900 and catalog 80290026 against all 218 stores in the same list: EXACTLY 140 countries share this identical storeId+catalogId pair, including a literal entry countryCode='WW' (World Wide) -- i.e. India is bundled into Zara Home's generic 'Rest of World' international-shipping catalogue, not a dedicated per-country population like UAE (85009931/50333562), UK (84009906/80290024), DE (84009904/80290000) or ES (84009900/80290093), each of which is store-unique. (3) The live URL for this shared WW catalogue was found by direct guess: https://www.zarahome.com/ww/ returns 200, title 'Zara Home Worldwide | Official website', 792KB of real rendered content; its embedded appconfig reads storeId 88009900, catalogId 80290026, languageId -1 (en-US) -- an EXACT match to India's own store-list entry, confirming /ww/ is genuinely the catalogue India customers are served through (no India-specific alternative exists). Access route: same Akamai interstitial solver (pipeline/final_list_batch_sn21-30/inditex_interstitial_solver.py, curl_cffi chrome impersonation) used unmodified for AE/UK/DE/ES/FR worked identically here -- 7th consecutive Zara Home country confirming the solver's cross-country reliability. robots.txt fetched in full (5840 bytes) -- no Claude/ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai disallow found. DUPLICATE-COMPANY DETERMINATION: /ww/ is NOT independent -- its store/catalog IDs (88009900/80290026) are shared across 140 countries, so if this project processes any other 'Rest of World' country from that list (e.g. Pakistan, Nigeria, Vietnam, Kyrgyzstan) as a separate S.N., that row would read this exact same catalogue and should be flagged/treated as a duplicate of this one, the same way S.N.153 (ES re-listing) was handled against S.N.127. CATALOGUE IS GENUINELY MUCH SMALLER than the 6 dedicated-store countries: /ww/'s own top-level mega-menu (server-rendered cat-v2-* nodes on the homepage) lists only 8 top categories -- BEDDING, HOME DECOR, BATHROOM, KIDS AND BABY, CLOTHING AND FOOTWEAR, LAUNDRY CARE, CULINARY STORIES (an editorial/blog landing, not a product category -- excluded per the same rule ES's notes already established for culinary-stories-* pages), WITHDRAWAL OF ITEMS -- there is no 'LIGHTING' or 'MIRRORS' or 'KITCHEN & DINING'/dining top-level node at all. Systematically re-queried all 38 categoryIds used across the 5 available prior-country archives (union of AE/UK/DE/ES/FR leaf categoryIds) against store 88009900/catalog 80290026 via /itxrest/3/catalog/store/88009900/80290026/category/<id>/product?showProducts=false&showNoStock=false&withSubCategories=false&languageId=-1&appId=1: ALL Lighting ids (Table/Ceiling/Floor/Wall/Bedroom/Kids/Bathroom Lamps) and ALL Mirror ids (Bedroom/Wall/Full Length/Table/Irregular/Bathroom Mirrors) either 404 (category not found in this catalog) or 200-with-zero-productIds; ALL Kitchen & Dining ids (Dinner Sets/Plates, Soup Plates, Dessert Plates, Bowls, Cups and Mugs, Serving Dishes, Tumblers, Glasses, Borosilicate, Ice Cream Glasses, Trays, Cruets, Coasters, Napkin Holders, Charger Plates, Sugar Bowls) either 404 or 200-with-zero-productIds. Independently confirmed via direct page fetch: the Mirrors landing page (home-decor-mirrors-living-room-n993) and Lighting landing page (lighting-lamps-n4847), both linked from the WW Home Decor page's own template, both 404 on the WW domain (Error Page) -- the site's own template exposes the link but the destination does not exist for this store, matching the API's null population. Only 6 of the 38 known ids returned nonzero productIds on WW: Decorative Accessories (1090529)=32, Vases and Planters (1089525)=37, Candle Holders (1179510)=18, Flowerpots/Planters (1020300631)=2, Hooks (1090528)=10, and Bottles and Jugs (1089119)=2. All 6 independently re-queried in a second pass minutes later -- identical counts, no drift. Verified working, live SEO URLs exist for 5 of these 6 (home-decor-n989 'Home decor and living room', vases-decorative-planters-n1010 'Vases and planters', candle-holders-n1003 'Candlesticks and candle holders', home-decor-planters-n1402 'Pots and planters for every room', hooks-n4857 'Clothing Hooks' -- decorative wall hooks, same categoryId/treatment as all 4 prior countries) -- all return 200 with matching titles. Bottles and Jugs (1089119, qty 2) is OMITTED: its API grid returns productIds=2 but no working PLP URL was found for it on the WW domain -- tried its own-country slug pattern and several nonsense-slug+real-id variants (all 404, unlike ES/DE/UK where the same trick reliably 200'd/redirected), i.e. it is present in the catalog backend but not published/reachable via any live page, matching the exact precedent set by c21 (AE) which likewise omitted Tumblers and Cordless Lamps for identical no-working-URL reasons. RULE 0 note: no room-organized Lighting exists at all on this catalogue to test Rule 0 against (confirmed absent, not merely excluded for a room-word reason). No Clocks category exists as a standalone node; one individual product ('FLIP CLOCK') was found embedded inside the Decorative Accessories grid itself (category DECORATIVE ACCESSORIES per its own product metadata) -- already counted within that leaf's qty=32, no separate row warranted. No artificial-plants category, no wallpaper, matching all prior countries. Checked BATHROOM top-menu node in full via its towels page's own sidebar links (18 sibling links) -- entirely non-decorative/excluded items (soap dispensers/dishes, trays, toothbrush tumblers, towel racks/boxes, laundry baskets, bins, bathmats, bathrobes, shower curtains, self-care) or textiles, same exclusion set ES already established; no genuinely decorative bathroom accessory or bathroom mirror found (bathroom mirrors categoryId 1020304507 = 404 on WW). Excluded per brief scope (same categories all 5 prior countries excluded, confirmed present but excluded here too where checked: bedding/bed linen, bathroom textiles/storage/fixtures, kids/baby non-decor, clothing and footwear, laundry/cleaning products, door knobs and handles n1005 (hardware, 200 on WW but out of scope), baskets/storage n997, culinary-stories editorial pages, careers/corporate pages, withdrawn-from-sale n5187).
